line.issue: Extension "nr_vault" is having an ext_emconf.php file, which is deprecated. Additionally the composer.json is missing "version" and "providesPackages" declaration. See https://docs.typo3.org/permalink/changelog:deprecation-108345-1774126701@14.3 for details.

Automatic TCA migration done during bootstrap. Please adapt TCA accordingly, these migrations will be removed. The backend module "Configuration -> TCA" shows the modified values. Please adapt these areas: The 'tx_nrllm_configuration' TCA configuration 'searchFields' inside the 'ctrl' section is not evaluated anymore and is therefore removed. Suitable field types, e.g. 'input' are now automatically considered, while using the 'searchable' field config for specific exclusion can be used. Please adjust your TCA accordingly.
